data.title: 黑歌 · 暮色缘侧的和服青烟微醺
data.description: 落日余晖洒满日式回廊，黑歌半倚缘侧立柱，黑底金纹宽松和服滑落半肩，指尖细长烟管吐出淡淡青烟。
data.action: 半倚木柱侧坐，手持长柄铜烟管轻吐薄雾，眼神迷离注视庭前落枫
data.lighting: 温暖如蜜的夕阳橙红光芒斜照，长长阴影与薄烟微光交织
data.camera: 中景侧平视，捕捉和服褶皱与侧颜轮廓
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, kuroka, nekomata, black cat ears, twin tails, two black cat tails, golden eyes, loose black kimono with gold floral patterns, off-shoulder kimono revealing collarbone, holding traditional kiseru pipe, delicate smoke swirling in air, sitting on wooden engawa porch, sunset orange glow, traditional japanese garden in background.
data.animaCaption: 1girl, solo, kuroka, cat ears, two tails, loose black kimono off-shoulder, smoking kiseru pipe on veranda at sunset.
